{{< include _setup.qmd >}}

People with at least one commit that year to any public repo in the
[napari GitHub org](https://github.com/napari). *New* means their first
commit to any of them.

## New contributors by release

From the author lists in each release's notes.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="minimal"}
## Every napari release

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML

releases = pd.read_csv("../fellowship/final-report/new-contributors-by-release.csv")
table = releases[["release", "release_date", "new_contributors"]].iloc[::-1]
table.columns = ["Release", "Date", "New contributors"]
HTML(table.to_html(index=False, classes="table table-sm", border=0))
```
